mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device_network_version SET conp_version=#{conpVersion}, conp_type=#{conpType}, conp_series=#{conpSeries}, conp_mark=#{conpMark}, boot_version=#{bootVersion}, cpld_version=#{cpldVersion}, pcb_version=#{pcbVersion}, customized=#{customized}, effective_from=#{effectiveFrom}, source_system=#{sourceSystem}, source_key=#{sourceKey}, source_version=#{sourceVersion}, source_updated_at=#{sourceUpdatedAt}, synced_at=#{syncedAt}, sync_status=#{syncStatus}, version=COALESCE(version,0)+1, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=b'0'

UPDATE ast_device SET conp_version=#{conpVersion}, conp_type=#{conpType}, conp_series=#{conpSeries}, conp_mark=#{conpMark}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND deleted=b'0'
